desc:
• PROTEIN BARS: Every delicious 90 calorie chocolate chip flavored protein bar has 10g of protein; A good source of protein

  • KETO* FRIENDLY: 1g sugar and 2g net carbs† per serving; †2g net carbs = 10g total carbs - 5g fiber - 2g sugar alcohol - 1g allulose; *Always consult your physician before starting an eating plan that involves regular consumption of high fat foods

  • A GOOD SOURCE OF FIBER: Each serving has 5g fiber (total fat 2.5g, sat. fat 2g)

  • SNACK BARS: Feel like one smart cookie when you say 'yes' to your sweet tooth; An ideal office or lunch box snack, part of breakfast, or on the go treat

  • CONTAINS: One 4.8 oz box of Protein One 90 Calorie Chocolate Chip Protein Bars; 5 bars
features: Protein One 90 Calorie Protein Bars in Chocolate Chip flavor are a smart and satisfying choice for anyone watching their calories without compromising on taste. Each bar contains only 90 calories and offers a good source of protein, making it ideal for a quick snack or post-workout fuel. These bars are keto-friendly, helping to support low-carb lifestyles while still providing the energy and nutrients your body needs. With a rich chocolate chip flavor and a soft, chewy texture, they’re perfect for curbing cravings without the guilt. Plus, the convenient 5-count pack makes them easy to grab on the go or keep at your desk or in your gym bag.
ingredients: Chicory Root Extract, Soy Protein Isolate, Whey Protein Isolate, Erythritol, Palm Kernel Oil, Vegetable Glycerin, Water, Semisweet Chocolate Chips (sugar, unsweetened chocolate, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, vanillin), Calcium Caseinate, Cocoa Powder, Soy Lecithin, Collagen, Salt, Dutch Cocoa (processed with alkali), Stevia Extract, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Canola Oil.
